originalAlarm.description: `ops` could be null (null value originating from line 19) and is dereferenced in the call to `irq_domain_add()`.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE true)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN true)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ false))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  false)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): 6252547b8a7.c (Linux TWL4030). NULLPTR_DEREFERENCE on 'ops' at line 25 — ops is initialized to NULL at line 19, only assigned inside #ifdef CONFIG_OF_IRQ (line 22), so when OF_IRQ=false, ops remains NULL and is passed to irq_domain_add() which dereferences it. This is the known vbdb NullDereference bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: TWL4030_CORE=true is required (to enter twl_probe where ops is used), OF_IRQ=false is required (so ops is never assigned). CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN=true is redundant since lines 3-5 (#ifdef CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE / #define CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN) mean it is always true when TWL4030_CORE=true — but including it does not over-constrain the result since no real configs satisfy TWL4030_CORE=true && IRQ_DOMAIN=false. The presence condition correctly identifies all configurations where the bug manifests.
